subtitle: AI scouts that shop for you
promotionalText: Your own squad of AI scouts hunts drops, restocks and deals across the web, learns your taste, and texts you when they find something you'll love.
reviewNotes: Sign in: tap 'Continue with email', then 'Sign in', and use the demo account below. The account has three scouts with real finds. Baget Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) on the Pro screen, reachable from Settings > Go Pro.
